name: Chartix (NSE technical analysis)
description: NSE charting, chart patterns with Chartix's own backtested win rates, scans, watchlists and chart deep links. End-of-day and intraday bars for 3,017 NSE equities.

_notes.mcp_server_url: Must be a public https URL — Quantcept's website connectors refuse localhost. For local use, skip this file and point the Quantcept terminal's /mcp at http://127.0.0.1:8420/ instead.
_notes.auth: This protects the MCP SERVER, not Chartix. It is not the Chartix credential: that lives in the server's own CHARTIX_TOKEN env var and must never be sent from Quantcept. If the server runs on loopback only, set "auth": {"type": "none"}.
_notes.before_exposing_this: The server holds a Chartix login JWT with that user's full authority, writes included — anyone who can reach an exposed instance acts as that user. Paid data is separately gated at the API (intraday requires eod_pro server-side). Read chartix-mcp-server/README.md 'Hosting' before putting this on a public URL.
_notes.plan: Website connectors and custom skills need a Quantcept Alpha or Apex 30-day pass. Both are paused, not deleted, when a pass ends.
